FB-GEM.id: Permata ini masuk ke Kotak Permatamu.
FB-GEM.en: This gem goes into your Gem box.

FBH-01-002-cut_queue.id: Hampir! Ingat, teman-teman menunjuk ke ujung antrean. {model}
FBH-01-002-cut_queue.en: Almost! Remember, the others pointed to the end of the line. {model}

FBH-01-002-interrupt.id: Hampir! Di cerita, tidak ada yang menyela. Coba ingat siapa yang menunggu. {model}
FBH-01-002-interrupt.en: Almost! No one cut in on anyone in the story. Think about who waited. {model}

FBH-01-006-b.id: Hampir! Kata-kata kasar bisa membuatnya marah, bukan pindah. {model}
FBH-01-006-b.en: Almost! Rude words can make someone angry instead of moving. {model}

FBH-01-006-c.id: Hampir! Kalau ikut menyerobot, antrean makin kacau. {model}
FBH-01-006-c.en: Almost! Pushing in too makes the queue even messier. {model}

FBH-01-007-sorry.id: Hampir! Maaf kita ucapkan saat berbuat salah. Di sini temanmu menolong. {model}
FBH-01-007-sorry.en: Almost! We say sorry when we make a mistake. Here your friend is helping. {model}

FBH-01-007-wave_bye.id: Hampir! Dadah untuk berpisah. Temanmu baru saja menolong. {model}
FBH-01-007-wave_bye.en: Almost! Waving is for saying goodbye. Your friend has just helped you. {model}

FBH-01-010-b.id: Hampir! Temanmu jadi sedih dan membereskannya sendirian. {model}
FBH-01-010-b.en: Almost! Your friend feels sad and has to clean up alone. {model}

FBH-01-010-c.id: Hampir! Itu tidak jujur, dan mejanya tetap basah. {model}
FBH-01-010-c.en: Almost! That isn't honest, and the table is still wet. {model}

FBH-01-013-cut_queue.id: Hampir! Menyerobot membuat yang datang lebih dulu menunggu lebih lama. {model}
FBH-01-013-cut_queue.en: Almost! Pushing in makes the people who came first wait longer. {model}

FBH-01-013-interrupt.id: Hampir! Memotong juga berarti tidak menunggu giliran. {model}
FBH-01-013-interrupt.en: Almost! Cutting in also means not waiting your turn. {model}

FBH-01-014-thanks.id: Hampir! Terima kasih untuk saat dibantu. Kalau menyenggol, kita minta maaf. {model}
FBH-01-014-thanks.en: Almost! Thank you is for when someone helps. When we bump someone, we say sorry. {model}

FBH-01-014-wave_hello.id: Hampir! Menyapa itu baik, tapi temanmu baru saja tersenggol. {model}
FBH-01-014-wave_hello.en: Almost! Saying hello is nice, but your friend just got bumped. {model}

FBH-02-001-eat.id: Hampir! Makan sendiri boleh saja, tapi temanmu tetap lapar. {model}
FBH-02-001-eat.en: Almost! Eating alone is allowed, but your friend is still hungry. {model}

FBH-02-001-run.id: Hampir! Main dulu boleh nanti. Sekarang temanmu masih lapar. {model}
FBH-02-001-run.en: Almost! Playing can wait. Right now your friend is hungry. {model}

FBH-02-002-b.id: Hampir! Berbagi tidak perlu hadiah. Senangnya sudah terasa saat memberi. {model}
FBH-02-002-b.en: Almost! Sharing doesn't need a prize. Giving already feels good. {model}

FBH-02-002-c.id: Hampir! Bukan itu tujuannya. Berbagi membuat orang lain ikut merasakan. {model}
FBH-02-002-c.en: Almost! That's not the point. Sharing lets others enjoy it too. {model}

FBH-02-004-left_out.id: Hampir! Ia mungkin ingin ikut tapi malu. Kalau dibiarkan, ia tetap sendirian. {model}
FBH-02-004-left_out.en: Almost! Maybe they want to join but feel shy. If we leave them, they stay alone. {model}

FBH-02-004-read.id: Hampir! Membaca itu baik, tapi ia masih menunggu diajak. {model}
FBH-02-004-read.en: Almost! Reading is good, but they're still waiting to be asked. {model}

FBH-02-009-b.id: Hampir! Dompet itu bukan milik kita. Pemiliknya pasti sedang cemas mencarinya. {model}
FBH-02-009-b.en: Almost! It isn't ours. The owner must be worried and looking for it. {model}

FBH-02-009-c.id: Hampir! Dompet itu bisa hilang atau diambil orang. Lebih baik dititipkan. {model}
FBH-02-009-c.en: Almost! It could get lost or taken. It's better to hand it in. {model}

FBH-02-012-b.id: Hampir! Itu menyontek. Nilainya jadi bukan hasil belajarmu sendiri. {model}
FBH-02-012-b.en: Almost! That's copying. The mark wouldn't show what you really learned. {model}

FBH-02-012-c.id: Hampir! Itu tidak jujur. Lebih baik kerjakan yang kamu bisa. {model}
FBH-02-012-c.en: Almost! That isn't honest. It's better to do what you can. {model}

FBH-02-013-b.id: Hampir! Merebut membuat adik sedih dan kalian bisa bertengkar. {model}
FBH-02-013-b.en: Almost! Grabbing makes your sibling sad and starts a quarrel. {model}

FBH-02-013-c.id: Hampir! Kalau disembunyikan, tidak ada yang bisa bermain. {model}
FBH-02-013-c.en: Almost! If it's hidden, nobody can play. {model}

FBH-02-014-b.id: Hampir! Walau tidak ada yang tahu, uang itu milik penjual. {model}
FBH-02-014-b.en: Almost! Even if no one knows, the money belongs to the seller. {model}

FBH-02-014-c.id: Hampir! Uang itu bukan milikmu. Penjual bisa rugi. {model}
FBH-02-014-c.en: Almost! It isn't your money. The seller would lose out. {model}

FBH-03-001-watch_tv.id: Hampir! Menonton bisa nanti. Mainan yang berserakan bisa terinjak dan rusak. {model}
FBH-03-001-watch_tv.en: Almost! TV can wait. Toys on the floor can get stepped on and broken. {model}

FBH-03-001-sleep.id: Hampir! Mainannya masih berserakan. Rapikan dulu, yuk. {model}
FBH-03-001-sleep.en: Almost! The toys are still everywhere. Tidy up first. {model}

FBH-03-005-play.id: Hampir! Tangan yang kotor bisa membawa kuman ke makanan. Cuci tangan dulu. {model}
FBH-03-005-play.en: Almost! Dirty hands can carry germs to your food. Wash them first. {model}

FBH-03-005-watch_tv.id: Hampir! Menonton tidak membersihkan tangan. Cuci tangan dulu, yuk. {model}
FBH-03-005-watch_tv.en: Almost! Watching TV doesn't clean your hands. Let's wash them first. {model}

FBH-03-007-litter.id: Hampir! Sampah di jalan bisa menyumbat selokan dan membuat banjir. {model}
FBH-03-007-litter.en: Almost! Litter in the street can block drains and cause floods. {model}

FBH-03-010-b.id: Hampir! Halaman sekolah milik bersama. Satu tindakan kecil membuatnya bersih. {model}
FBH-03-010-b.en: Almost! The schoolyard belongs to everyone. One small act keeps it clean. {model}

FBH-03-010-c.id: Hampir! Sampahnya masih ada dan bisa terbawa angin. {model}
FBH-03-010-c.en: Almost! The rubbish is still there and can blow around. {model}

FBH-03-012-walk.id: Hampir! Kalau dibiarkan, air bersih terbuang percuma. {model}
FBH-03-012-walk.en: Almost! If we walk past, clean water is wasted. {model}

FBH-03-012-play.id: Hampir! Air bersih jangan dibuat main. Banyak orang membutuhkannya. {model}
FBH-03-012-play.en: Almost! Clean water isn't for playing. Lots of people need it. {model}

FBH-03-013-b.id: Hampir! Mereka pasti senang dibantu. Mainan itu milikmu, jadi kamu bisa merapikannya. {model}
FBH-03-013-b.en: Almost! They'd love the help. The toys are yours, so you can tidy them. {model}

FBH-03-013-c.id: Hampir! Mainan yang berserakan bisa terinjak dan rusak. {model}
FBH-03-013-c.en: Almost! Toys on the floor can get stepped on and broken. {model}

FBH-03-014-b.id: Hampir! Walau disembunyikan, sampah tetap mengotori taman. {model}
FBH-03-014-b.en: Almost! Even hidden, rubbish still spoils the park. {model}

FBH-03-014-c.id: Hampir! Sampah di semak bisa melukai hewan. {model}
FBH-03-014-c.en: Almost! Rubbish in bushes can hurt animals. {model}

body.id: Antre artinya menunggu giliran. Yang datang lebih dulu dilayani lebih dulu.
body.en: Queueing means waiting for your turn. Whoever comes first is served first.

body.id: Saat dibantu, kita bilang "terima kasih". Saat berbuat salah, kita bilang "maaf".
body.en: When someone helps us, we say "thank you". When we make a mistake, we say "sorry".

body.id: Kata-kata kecil ini membuat semua orang merasa dihargai.
body.en: These little words make everyone feel valued.

body.id: Berbagi artinya mengajak orang lain ikut menikmati: bekal, mainan, atau waktu bermain.
body.en: Sharing means letting others enjoy things too: snacks, toys or playtime.

body.id: Jujur artinya berkata dan berbuat sesuai yang sebenarnya, juga saat kita berbuat salah.
body.en: Being honest means saying and doing what is true, even when we've made a mistake.

body.id: Berbagi dan jujur membuat teman senang dan percaya pada kita.
body.en: Sharing and honesty make friends happy and help them trust us.

body.id: Kebersihan dimulai dari kita: merapikan mainan dan barang sendiri.
body.en: Keeping clean starts with us: tidying our own toys and things.

body.id: Sampah dibuang ke tempat sampah, dan air dipakai secukupnya.
body.en: Rubbish goes in the bin, and we use only the water we need.

body.id: Tempat yang bersih membuat semua orang nyaman dan sehat.
body.en: Clean places keep everyone comfortable and healthy.

ST-NIL-K-P-ANTRE.figure: Aya dan teman-teman (tokoh rekaan / fictional characters)
ST-NIL-K-P-ANTRE.source: Cerita asli AyaIlmu (fiksi) / AyaIlmu original story (fiction)

caption.id: Jam istirahat! Anak-anak antre membeli kue di kantin.
caption.en: Break time! The children queue up to buy snacks at the canteen.

caption.id: Seorang anak datang terburu-buru dan langsung ke depan.
caption.en: One child rushes in and goes straight to the front.

caption.id: Teman-teman menunjuk ujung antrean dengan ramah. Anak itu pun ikut menunggu giliran.
caption.en: The others kindly point to the end of the line. So the child waits for a turn too.

caption.id: Semua mendapat giliran. "Terima kasih!" kata mereka sambil tersenyum.
caption.en: Everyone gets a turn. "Thank you!" they say with a smile.

ST-NIL-K-P-JUJUR.figure: Aya dan teman-teman (tokoh rekaan / fictional characters)
ST-NIL-K-P-JUJUR.source: Cerita asli AyaIlmu (fiksi) / AyaIlmu original story (fiction)

caption.id: Di warung, Aya melihat seseorang mengembalikan uang kembalian yang kelebihan. Penjual tersenyum lega.
caption.en: At the warung, Aya sees someone hand back extra change. The seller smiles, relieved.

caption.id: Di taman, seorang anak menemukan dompet dan menyerahkannya kepada pemiliknya.
caption.en: In the park, a child finds a wallet and gives it back to its owner.

caption.id: Seorang anak lain berani berkata jujur tentang kesalahannya.
caption.en: Another child bravely tells the truth about a mistake.

caption.id: Aya tersenyum. Jujur kadang butuh berani, tapi hati jadi tenang dan orang lain percaya.
caption.en: Aya smiles. Honesty can take courage, but it brings a calm heart and people's trust.

model_answer.id: Antre itu adil: semua mendapat giliran.
model_answer.en: Queueing is fair: everyone gets a turn.

meaning.id: Apa yang akhirnya dilakukan semua anak?
meaning.en: What did all the children do in the end?

model_answer.id: Semua anak menunggu giliran, jadi semua mendapat kue dengan tenang.
model_answer.en: Everyone waited their turn, so everyone got a snack calmly.

meaning.en: How to queue well.

text.en: Find the end of the line
Step up when it's your turn

model_answer.id: Cari ujung antrean, berdiri di belakang orang terakhir, tunggu dengan sabar, lalu maju saat giliranmu.
model_answer.en: Find the end of the line, stand behind the last person, wait patiently, then step up on your turn.

meaning.id: Baik atau kurang baik saat menunggu?
meaning.en: Good or not so good while waiting?

text.en: Waiting for a turn on the swing
Cutting in while a friend is talking

model_answer.id: Baik: antre rapi, menunggu giliran, mendengarkan. Menyerobot dan memotong pembicaraan kurang baik, karena orang lain jadi kehilangan gilirannya.
model_answer.en: Good: queueing neatly, waiting your turn, listening. Pushing in and cutting in are not so good, because other people lose their turn.

meaning.id: Saat antre, yang datang lebih dulu dilayani lebih dulu.
meaning.en: In a queue, whoever comes first is served first.

model_answer.id: Itulah aturan antre. Adil, karena semua menunggu dengan cara yang sama.
model_answer.en: That's the queue rule. It's fair, because everyone waits the same way.

meaning.id: Ada yang menyerobot antrean. Apa yang bisa kamu katakan?
meaning.en: Someone pushes into the queue. What could you say?

text.id: "Maaf, antreannya mulai dari belakang sini, ya."
text.en: "Excuse me, the queue starts back here."
Say nothing, then push in too

model_answer.id: Beri tahu dengan ramah dan tunjukkan ujung antrean. Mungkin ia belum tahu.
model_answer.en: Tell them kindly and show them the end of the line. Maybe they didn't know.

meaning.en: A friend lends you a pencil.

model_answer.id: Terima kasih! Temanmu sudah menolongmu.
model_answer.en: Thank you! Your friend has helped you.

meaning.en: Gestures and their magic words.

model_answer.id: Tangan di dada: terima kasih. Malu-malu: maaf. Tangan terangkat: halo. Melambai sambil pergi: sampai jumpa.
model_answer.en: Palms together: thank you. A shy smile: sorry. A raised hand: hello. Waving while leaving: goodbye.

meaning.en: How to say sorry.

text.en: Stop and look at your friend
Name what happened: "I bumped your drawing."

model_answer.id: Berhenti, ucapkan maaf, sebutkan salahmu, lalu bantu memperbaikinya.
model_answer.en: Stop, say sorry, name what happened, then help put it right.

meaning.id: Kamu tidak sengaja menumpahkan minuman temanmu.
meaning.en: You accidentally spill your friend's drink.

text.en: Say sorry and help wipe it up

model_answer.id: Minta maaf dan bantu mengelap. Walau tidak sengaja, kita tetap bisa membantu.
model_answer.en: Say sorry and help wipe it up. Even when it's an accident, we can still help.

meaning.id: Ayah menyiapkan bekalku. Aku bilang, "____, Yah!"
meaning.en: Dad packs my lunch. I say, "____, Dad!"

model_answer.id: "Terima kasih, Yah!" Ayah sudah menyiapkan bekal untukmu.
model_answer.en: "Thank you, Dad!" He made lunch for you.

model_answer.id: Hari ini, ucapkan terima kasih kepada tiga orang: di rumah, di sekolah, dan di jalan. Lihat senyum mereka!
model_answer.en: Today, say thank you to three people: at home, at school and on the way. Watch them smile!

meaning.id: Kamu baru datang. Di toko ada antrean.
meaning.en: You've just arrived. There's a queue in the shop.

model_answer.id: Berdiri di ujung antrean dan tunggu giliranmu.
model_answer.en: Stand at the end of the line and wait your turn.

meaning.en: You accidentally bump into a friend.

model_answer.id: Bilang "maaf", lalu tanyakan apakah ia baik-baik saja.
model_answer.en: Say "sorry", then ask if they're okay.

meaning.en: Your friend forgot their lunch.

model_answer.id: Berbagi bekal membuat kalian berdua kenyang dan senang.
model_answer.en: Sharing your lunch means you're both full and happy.

meaning.en: Why is sharing good?

text.en: So the food is finished quickly

text.id: Teman ikut senang, kita juga senang
text.en: Our friend is happy, and so are we

model_answer.id: Saat berbagi, teman ikut senang, dan hati kita juga hangat.
model_answer.en: When we share, our friend is happy, and we feel warm inside too.

meaning.id: Berbagi mainan berarti mainanku jadi milik temanku selamanya.
meaning.en: Sharing a toy means it becomes my friend's forever.

model_answer.id: Berbagi berarti bermain bersama atau bergantian. Mainanmu tetap milikmu.
model_answer.en: Sharing means playing together or taking turns. Your toy is still yours.

meaning.id: Ada anak duduk sendirian saat kalian bermain.
meaning.en: A child sits alone while you all play.

model_answer.id: Ajak ia bermain bersama. Berbagi waktu bermain juga berbagi.
model_answer.en: Invite them to play. Sharing playtime is sharing too.

meaning.en: How to share a toy.

model_answer.id: Ajak bermain, sepakati siapa yang mulai, main bergantian, lalu rapikan bersama.
model_answer.en: Ask to play, agree who goes first, take turns, then tidy up together.

model_answer.id: Saat makan bersama keluarga, tawarkan lauk kepada orang lain sebelum mengambil untukmu. Lihat apa yang terjadi!
model_answer.en: At a family meal, offer the food to someone else before you take yours. See what happens!

model_answer.id: Jujur membuat hati tenang dan orang lain percaya.
model_answer.en: Honesty brings a calm heart and people's trust.

meaning.en: What did Aya see?

model_answer.id: Pertama uang kembalian di warung, lalu dompet di taman, lalu anak yang berkata jujur.
model_answer.en: First the change at the warung, then the wallet in the park, then the child who told the truth.

meaning.en: You find a wallet in the park.

text.id: Berikan kepada orang dewasa yang kupercaya
text.en: Give it to a grown-up I trust

model_answer.id: Berikan kepada orang dewasa yang kamu percaya, misalnya guru, satpam, atau orang tua, supaya kembali ke pemiliknya.
model_answer.en: Give it to a grown-up you trust, like a teacher, a guard or your parent, so it gets back to its owner.

meaning.id: Berkata jujur saat berbuat salah itu tindakan berani.
meaning.en: Telling the truth when you've made a mistake is brave.

model_answer.id: Jujur memang butuh berani, dan orang jadi bisa memercayaimu.
model_answer.en: Honesty takes courage, and it helps people trust you.

meaning.en: Good or not so good?

model_answer.id: Baik: berbagi, mengembalikan kembalian, berkata jujur. Kurang baik: menyontek, karena itu bukan hasil kerjamu sendiri, dan membiarkan teman sendirian, karena ia jadi sedih.
model_answer.en: Good: sharing, handing back change, telling the truth. Not so good: copying, because it isn't your own work, and leaving a friend out, because it makes them sad.

meaning.id: Saat ulangan, kamu lupa satu jawaban.
meaning.en: In a test, you forget one answer.

text.en: Tell the teacher my paper got lost

model_answer.id: Kerjakan sebisamu dengan jujur. Gurumu jadi tahu bagian mana yang perlu dipelajari lagi.
model_answer.en: Do your best, honestly. Then your teacher knows which part to help you with.

meaning.id: Kamu dan adikmu ingin main bola yang sama.
meaning.en: You and your little sibling want the same ball.

model_answer.id: Main bersama atau bergantian, supaya kalian berdua senang.
model_answer.en: Play together or take turns, so you're both happy.

meaning.en: You're given Rp2,000 too much change.

text.en: Keep it, no one will know
Give it back to the seller

model_answer.id: Kembalikan uang itu. Penjual akan berterima kasih dan percaya padamu.
model_answer.en: Give the money back. The seller will thank you and trust you.

items.source: Aknin, L. B., Hamlin, J. K., & Dunn, E. W. (2012). Giving leads to happiness in young children. PLoS ONE, 7(6), e39211. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0039211

model_answer.id: Para peneliti di Kanada mengamati anak-anak yang belum genap 2 tahun. Anak-anak tampak lebih gembira saat memberi camilan kepada sebuah boneka daripada saat menerima camilan sendiri, apalagi kalau camilan itu miliknya sendiri!
model_answer.en: Researchers in Canada watched children just under 2 years old. The children looked happier giving treats to a puppet than getting treats themselves, especially when the treats were their own!

meaning.en: Playtime is over and toys are everywhere.

model_answer.id: Rapikan mainan setelah bermain, supaya tidak terinjak dan mudah dicari lagi.
model_answer.en: Tidy up after playing, so nothing gets stepped on and you can find things again.

meaning.en: How to tidy up toys.

text.en: Put the box on its shelf

model_answer.id: Kumpulkan, masukkan ke kotak, taruh di rak, lalu cuci tangan.
model_answer.en: Gather them, put them in the box, put the box on the shelf, then wash your hands.

meaning.id: Merapikan kamar hanya tugas orang dewasa.
meaning.en: Tidying a bedroom is only a grown-up's job.

model_answer.id: Anak-anak juga bisa merapikan barangnya sendiri, dan itu sangat membantu keluarga.
model_answer.en: Children can tidy their own things too, and it really helps the family.

meaning.en: Put each thing in its place.

model_answer.id: Buku di rak buku, sepatu di rak sepatu, baju kotor di keranjang cucian, sikat gigi di gelasnya.
model_answer.en: Books on the bookshelf, shoes on the shoe rack, dirty clothes in the laundry basket, the toothbrush in its cup.

meaning.en: It's almost lunchtime.

model_answer.id: Cuci tangan pakai sabun sebelum makan, supaya kuman tidak ikut termakan.
model_answer.en: Wash your hands with soap before eating, so germs don't end up in your food.

model_answer.id: Pilih satu sudut kamarmu. Rapikan dalam 5 menit bersama orang di rumah, lalu lihat bedanya!
model_answer.en: Pick one corner of your room. Tidy it in 5 minutes with someone at home, then see the difference!

meaning.en: You've finished your sweet. The wrapper?

model_answer.id: Buang ke tempat sampah. Kalau tidak ada, simpan dulu di saku atau tas.
model_answer.en: Put it in the bin. If there isn't one, keep it in your pocket or bag for now.

meaning.en: Good or not so good?

model_answer.id: Baik: membuang sampah di tempatnya, menutup keran, merapikan kelas. Membuang sampah sembarangan dan menyerobot antrean kurang baik, karena merugikan orang lain.
model_answer.en: Good: using the bin, turning off the tap, tidying the classroom. Littering and pushing into a queue are not so good, because they make things worse for others.

meaning.id: Menutup keran saat menyikat gigi membantu menghemat air.
meaning.en: Turning off the tap while you brush your teeth saves water.

model_answer.id: Air bersih sangat berharga. Buka keran hanya saat perlu.
model_answer.en: Clean water is precious. Turn the tap on only when you need it.

meaning.id: Ada sampah di halaman sekolah. Bukan punyamu.
meaning.en: There's rubbish in the schoolyard. It isn't yours.

text.id: Pungut dan buang ke tempat sampah
text.en: Pick it up and put it in the bin

model_answer.id: Pungut dan buang. Kalau sampahnya tajam atau kotor sekali, minta tolong orang dewasa.
model_answer.en: Pick it up and bin it. If it's sharp or very dirty, ask a grown-up for help.

meaning.id: Pasangkan dengan cara yang lebih baik.
meaning.en: Match each with a better way.

model_answer.id: Sampah ke tempat sampah, antre dengan rapi, dan ajak teman yang sendirian.
model_answer.en: Rubbish in the bin, queue neatly, and invite the friend who's alone.

meaning.en: Someone left a tap running.

model_answer.id: Tutup kerannya. Kalau kerannya rusak, beri tahu orang dewasa.
model_answer.en: Turn it off. If the tap is broken, tell a grown-up.

meaning.en: Who should tidy up your toys?

text.en: Me, with help if I need it

model_answer.id: Kamu sendiri, dan boleh minta bantuan kalau perlu.
model_answer.en: You do, and it's fine to ask for help.

meaning.id: Di taman tidak ada tempat sampah.
meaning.en: There's no bin in the park.

text.id: Simpan dulu di tas, buang nanti
text.en: Keep it in my bag, bin it later

model_answer.id: Simpan dulu di tas, lalu buang saat menemukan tempat sampah.
model_answer.en: Keep it in your bag, then bin it when you find a bin.

meaning.id: Aku dua kata ajaib. Kamu mengucapkanku saat ada yang menolongmu. Siapa aku?
meaning.en: I'm two magic words. You say me when someone helps you. What am I?

model_answer.id: Terima kasih!
model_answer.en: Thank you!
